usage: Use NotificationCenter to communicate important information, status updates, or feedback to users. This component is designed to draw attention to messages that require user awareness or action.

NotificationCenter works well for transient notifications, validation messages, and system status indicators. Avoid using it for content that should persist on the page or for non-critical information that doesn't require immediate attention.

anatomy.description: NotificationCenter is composed of the following parts:

bestPractices.title: Use appropriate severity
bestPractices.description: Match the alert variant to the message importance (info, warning, error).

bestPractices.title: Don't overuse error styling
bestPractices.description: Reserve error variants for actual errors, not warnings or info.

bestPractices.title: Provide actionable messages
bestPractices.description: Include clear next steps or resolution options.

bestPractices.title: Don't show vague messages
bestPractices.description: Avoid generic messages without context or actions.

bestPractices.title: Don't auto-dismiss important alerts
bestPractices.description: Never auto-dismiss error messages or critical information.
